projects.name: ShadowEngineer-AWS-Hackathon-2025
projects.description: AI Onboarding Copilot, 3rd place at the AWS Agentic AI Hackathon NYC 2025. Transcribes team meetings with Deepgram, and a Bedrock agent maps them to Jira tickets, docs and action items for new engineers.

projects.name: agentgate

projects.name: streamledger
projects.description: Event-sourced, CQRS ledger for balances and inventory: append-only events, optimistic concurrency and dedupe keys mean concurrent or retried writes can never double-spend.

projects.name: netcode-arena
projects.description: Server-authoritative multiplayer netcode built from scratch: client-side prediction, server reconciliation and snapshot interpolation over UDP, tested under injected latency and packet loss.

projects.name: accountill
projects.description: MERN invoicing platform for freelancers and small businesses: create, email and download PDF invoices, receipts, estimates and quotes, with due dates and a business dashboard.

projects.name: scholarly-insights
projects.description: Team-built app for discovering and discussing arXiv research papers, with threaded comments and notifications. Django REST backend with arXiv API integration and a React frontend.

projects.name: ecommerce-microservice-backend-app
projects.description: Cloud-native e-commerce backend split into Spring Boot / Spring Cloud microservices (users, products, orders, payments) behind an API gateway with service discovery and central config.

projects.name: sql-datawarehouse-project
projects.description: Medallion data warehouse on SQL Server: ERP/CRM CSVs land in Bronze, get cleansed and standardized in Silver, and are published as an analytics-ready Gold star schema with quality checks.

projects.name: build-a-recommendation-engine-example-with-spring-boot-and-aerospike
projects.description: Product recommendation engine built with Spring Boot, using Aerospike as a low-latency store for user behaviour and item similarity lookups.

projects.name: centralized-asset-management-system-with-compliance-self-audit-dashboard
projects.description: Centralized security dashboard across Linux and Windows machines: continuous security assessment, CIS Benchmark compliance checks and data-loss-prevention status, shown live in a Node.js dashboard.

projects.name: bloodbank

projects.description: CarFinder.com: a responsive car-browsing website for exploring models from different manufacturers.

projects.name: LeetCode-Bootcamp-Fall-2025-Solutions
projects.description: Weekly solutions from a Fall 2025 LeetCode bootcamp, covering core data structures and algorithms in Python.
